name: Dylan's Split-Flap
subtitle: A split-flap board of quotes, like the old train stations
description: A split-flap board, like the great departure boards in old train stations: every letter a drum of real-looking flaps that fall, clack and settle, with a new inspirational quote flipping in every minute.
Best on an iPad held sideways (it works upright too). Swipe up for the next quote, down for the one before. It starts muted: tap the speaker for the clatter.
features: Flaps that fall and land like real ones
Swipe up or down to change the quote
